description: Check which account this session acts on, before acting: with an account, the answer names it (account.email, masked like "thi•••@gmail.com", never in full), its offer (fondateur = founder account, everything included; organisation = Organisation; agence = Agency; pro; gratuit = free) and the connection (oauth with the name your AI declared, or account_token with the token's name; null when none was given), with the tier (anonymous / free / pro) and its limits. If the account or the offer is not the one the person asked you to use, stop and tell them. Call this after configuring an account token (dyk_...) to confirm it is recognized: an invalid token silently degrades to anonymous (authenticated: false, no account).
name: dropyour_whoami
title: Check my Dropyour account
